assignments.reason: דעת (knowledge/awareness of God) is the central concept of Torah #21's second half. The Torah states that all suffering comes from lack of דעת, and that eternal life comes through דעת. Its essential nature is the perfected state of divine influx (שפע אלקי) — when the surrounding lights have been fully internalized, the result IS דעת. It belongs with the divine influx cluster, not the brain-organ cluster, because דעת here is specifically the divine knowledge that transcends human intellect.

Knowledge of God Himself (דעת אותו יתברך) is the specific, ultimate form of דעת. The Torah states 'עקר הכלליות שיהיה נכלל באחד הוא על ידי הדעת אותו יתברך' — through knowing God one is included in His unity. Its essential nature is the divine influx in its most perfected, God-directed form.

ידיעה (knowing) is the faculty through which one is 'included in Him' (נכללים בו). The Torah cites 'אלו ידעתיו, הייתיו' — if I knew Him, I would be Him. Its essential nature is the divine knowledge-faculty, the active form of שפע אלקי as experienced by the knower.

The state of 'when knowledge is completed' (כשנשלם הדעת) refers to the perfected divine knowledge. The Torah states: 'וכשנשלם הדעת, אזי נשלם כל החסרונות'. Its essential nature is the culmination of the divine influx process — the moment all מקיפין have become פנימי.

This node explicitly defines the completion of knowledge as 'when מקיפים become פנימיים.' Its essential nature IS the מקיפין in their final, internalized state — the divine influx fully absorbed. The Torah connects this directly to salvation from all troubles through the חשמל/לבוש (already in Package 1).

Redemption (גאולה) is produced by דעת ('עקר הגאלה על ידי הדעת'), and the Torah specifically identifies it with the revelation of divine knowledge — when exile (=lack of דעת) ends. Its essential nature in this Torah is the collective, national manifestation of perfected divine influx. It belongs with the שפע-אלקי cluster as the historical/cosmic expression of that reality.

assignments.node_id: לא יחסר כל טוב, ויהיה כלו טוב
assignments.reason: The eschatological state of 'lacking nothing good, all being good' is the result of perfected דעת: 'ומחמת הדעת לא יחסר כל טוב'. Its essential nature is the fullness of divine goodness that flows from complete knowledge of God — the ultimate fruit of the divine influx being fully realized.

Being 'included in Him' (נכללים בו) is the state of unity with God achieved through ידיעה. 'על ידי הידיעה נכללים בו, כמאמר החכם: אלו ידעתיו, הייתיו'. Its essential nature is divine unity — the ultimate destination of the שפע אלקי process, where knower and known merge.

The 'essence of inclusion — being included in the One' is the foundational principle of divine unity through knowledge. Its essential nature is the same as נכללים בו — the state of absorption in God's oneness, the goal toward which all שפע אלקי flows.

The completion of all deficiencies (נשלם כל החסרונות) occurs when דעת is perfected: 'אם דעת קנית מה חסרת'. Its essential nature is wholeness/completeness — the state of having no lack because divine knowledge fills everything. This is the שפע-אלקי cluster in its attribute of all-sufficiency.

Being saved from all troubles (נצול מכל צרות) results from שלמות הדעת when מקיפים become פנימיים. The Torah connects this specifically to the לבוש/חשמל (garment/electrum, already in Package 1): 'מלבוש בגימטריא חשמל, ומהחשמל בורחים כל המשחיתים'. Its essential nature is the protective power of the divine surrounding-light — the מקיפין in their defensive function.

The process of 'bringing the surrounding lights inward' (להכניס המקיפין לפנים) is the core dynamic of Package 1 — the transition of the divine influx from external/surrounding to internal/absorbed. Its essential nature IS the מקיפין in their movement toward internalization. This is what the entire שפע-אלקי framework describes.

The heart's enthusiasm (התלהבות הלב) is born from the rapid movement of divine intellect. The Torah's opening verse 'שתהא שלהבת עולה מאליה' — that the flame rises by itself — IS this phenomenon. Its essential nature is the experiential sign of שפע אלקי being active: when divine influx arrives without preparation (=קדם/פנים), the heart naturally flames. It belongs with the divine influx cluster as its felt, warmth-giving manifestation.

The flame of the heart rising by itself (שלהבת הלב עולה תמיד מאליה) is the Torah's opening image from the verse 'בהעלתך את הנרות... שתהא שלהבת עולה מאליה'. This self-arising flame IS the divine influx manifesting through the menorah-candles. Its essential nature is שפע אלקי in its visible, spontaneous form — the flame that needs no human ignition because the divine source generates it.

The movement of the intellect (תנועת השכל) is the brain in its kinetic, active state. The Torah states: 'התלהבות הלב נולד מחמת תנועת השכל, כי טבע התנועות שמוליד חם'. Its essential nature is the intellect/brain (מח/שכל) in motion — the dynamic aspect of the human mind. It belongs with the brain-organ cluster, not the divine influx cluster, because it is the HUMAN intellect's activity (even if triggered by divine influx).

The sanctification of the seven candles (קדשת שבעת הנרות) is the ethical practice of purifying the seven openings of the head — mouth, nostrils, eyes, ears. The Torah specifies: 'לקדש את עיניו שלא להסתכל... וכן לקדש פיו וחטמו ואזניו'. Its essential nature is the HEAD'S ORGANS in their sanctified state — the menorah-of-the-head being purified. It belongs with the brain-organ cluster as the ethical dimension of those organs.

Same essential nature as קדשת שבעת הנרות — the act of sanctifying the seven candles (head-organs). The Torah uses both forms ('שמקדשין' and 'קדשת') to describe the same practice of guarding the mouth, nose, eyes, and ears. Belongs with the brain-organ cluster.

assignments.node_id: שיקדש את פיו וחטמו ועיניו ואזניו
assignments.reason: Sanctifying mouth, nose, eyes, and ears (שיקדש את פיו וחטמו ועיניו ואזניו) is the most explicit form of the seven-candle sanctification. The Torah details each organ's sanctification: guarding speech from falsehood (פה), cultivating fear of heaven (חטם), having faith in the sages (אזנים), closing eyes from seeing evil (עינים). Its essential nature is the HEAD ORGANS themselves in their ethical-spiritual practice — the menorah being tended.

The cry (הצעקה) is the labor-cry during the concealment state of the intellect. The Torah equates it with צעקת היולדת (the birth-cry, already in Package 3): 'יפה צעקה לאדם — בין בתפלה בין בתורה — כשנתעלם המחין'. Its essential nature is the voice-action of the concealment-birth cycle — it IS the עבור state expressing itself vocally.

Crying in Torah and prayer (צעקה בתורה ותפלה) is the specific form of the labor-cry during intellectual concealment. The Torah states: 'על ידי צעקה בתורה ותפלה זוכין להוליד המחין מתעלומותן'. Its essential nature is the same as הצעקה — the birthing-cry during the gestation/concealment state. Torah and prayer here are the medium, but the concept's nature is the cry-during-concealment.

The need to cry out (שצריך לצעק) is the imperative form of the concealment-cry. 'שבעת ימים... שבעים קלין הנ"ל שצריך לצעק כדי להוציא אור הפנים הנ"ל מהעלם אל הגלוי'. Its essential nature is the labor-cry imperative within the עבור/העלם cycle.

Meriting to birth the intellect from concealment (זוכין להוליד המחין מתעלומותן) is the BIRTH EVENT within the concealment cycle. It is the moment when עבור transitions to לדה (birth, already in Package 3). Its essential nature is the birthing-transition within the gestation-revelation cycle.

The birthing of the intellect (מולדת המחין) is the same birth-event: 'הקדוש ברוך הוא... הוא מאזין צעקתנו... ואז מולדת המחין'. Its essential nature is לדה (birth, already in Package 3) — the moment the concealed intellect emerges into revelation.

assignments.node_id: להוציא אור הפנים הנ"ל מהעלם אל הגלוי
assignments.reason: Bringing forth the light of the face from concealment to revelation (להוציא אור הפנים מהעלם אל הגלוי) explicitly describes the העלם→גלוי transition. Although 'אור הפנים' is Package 1 material, the PROCESS described here — the movement from העלם to גלוי — is the essential dynamic of Package 3. The concept's nature is the transition itself, not the light that transitions.
